item.title: Continuous dog fouling and fly tipping in recycled bins, 2nd November
item.description:
Every month, I walk past and see continuous dog walkers and public personel dumping their rubbish into recycled bins causing toxic waste to hazard issues for the environment. My relative lives there and we have moved the bins away and someone brought them back or tried emptying ourselves yet still people have the decency to dump rubbish. When is the council going out cctv or even dog bins nearby to prevent this from happening? How about fines? I’m tired of this mind you - the local politicians do nothing yet we voted for them for what?! I’m this close to contacting the BBC about this because even they reported on Brent’s issues of fly tipping malign people aware of their disgusting behaviour!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Highland Road, Shortlands, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
